item.title: Dog trainer facing felony animal abuse charges after dogs suffered injuries
item.description: In Eaton County, Michigan, Samantha Sullinger pleaded not guilty to felony charges on Thursday after one-year-old golden retriever Baylor allegedly suffered severe injuries at her Potterville facility. Sullinger, 28, who operates Sam’s Train, Play, and Stay, faces a felony count of abandoning/cruelty to four to 10 animals. item.title: Friendly antlerless deer with ‘PET’ painted in fluorescent paint on flanks
item.description: In Caldwell, Pennsylvania, a very friendly buck has been approaching vehicles and families. What’s particularly unusual is that the word “PET” has been spray painted a bright orange on both flanks. The very tame and extremely friendly domestic deer was likely painted identifying him as a pet to avoid him being hunted.
